title: Connect to your server
intro: Enter the address of your Suwayomi server, the same one you open in a browser at home.

problem.url_not_http: The address must start with http:// or https://.

warning.tailscale: This is a Tailscale address. The Switch has no Tailscale app, so it can't reach it. Use the server's address on your home network instead, for example http://192.168.1.10:4567.
warning.password_http: The password goes over plain http://, so anyone on the same Wi-Fi could read it. Use a password you don't use anywhere else.
warning.password_sd: The password is saved on the SD card as plain text.
warning.use_ip: Tip: use the server's IP address (like 192.168.1.10). Looking up a name is slow on the Switch.
